sub_graphs.title: Cancun Comparison Instructions: Stack State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models how comparison opcodes transform stack state through pop/push operations and computation

nodes.label: Stack Contains Comparison Operands
nodes.description: EVM stack has at least 2 values (or 1 for is_zero) ready for comparison operation

nodes.label: Pop Left Operand from Stack
nodes.description: Remove the first operand (left) from stack top for comparison

nodes.label: Pop Right Operand from Stack
nodes.description: Remove the second operand (right) from stack for comparison

nodes.label: Operands Loaded for Comparison
nodes.description: Both operands have been popped and are ready for comparison computation

nodes.label: Execute Unsigned Less-Than Comparison
nodes.description: Compare left < right using unsigned integer comparison

nodes.label: Execute Signed Less-Than Comparison
nodes.description: Convert operands to signed integers and compare left < right

nodes.label: Execute Unsigned Greater-Than Comparison
nodes.description: Compare left > right using unsigned integer comparison

nodes.label: Execute Signed Greater-Than Comparison
nodes.description: Convert operands to signed integers and compare left > right

nodes.label: Execute Equality Comparison
nodes.description: Compare left == right for equality

nodes.label: Comparison Result Computed
nodes.description: Boolean comparison result is ready (true/false)

nodes.label: Convert Boolean Result to U256
nodes.description: Convert boolean true to U256(1), false to U256(0)

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push the U256 comparison result back onto the stack

nodes.label: Stack Contains Comparison Result
nodes.description: Stack now has U256(1) or U256(0) as the comparison result at top

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance program counter by 1 to next instruction

nodes.label: Comparison Instruction Complete
nodes.description: Comparison instruction fully executed, ready for next opcode

sub_graphs.title: Cancun ISZERO Instruction: Unary Comparison
sub_graphs.description: Models the is_zero opcode which performs a unary comparison (single operand)

nodes.label: Stack Contains Value for Zero Check
nodes.description: EVM stack has at least 1 value for zero comparison

nodes.label: Pop Value for Zero Check
nodes.description: Remove single operand from stack top

nodes.label: Value Loaded for Zero Comparison
nodes.description: Single operand ready for zero comparison

nodes.label: Execute ISZERO Comparison
nodes.description: Check if value equals zero

nodes.label: Value Is Zero
nodes.description: Comparison determined value == 0, result is true

nodes.label: Value Is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Comparison determined value != 0, result is false

nodes.label: Push ISZERO Result
nodes.description: Push U256(1) if was zero, U256(0) if non-zero

nodes.label: ISZERO Instruction Complete
nodes.description: ISZERO finished, stack has result

ambiguities.text: The documentation does not explicitly detail error conditions or edge cases beyond standard stack underflow scenarios
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM stack underflow behavior applies: if fewer than required operands on stack, raise StackUnderflowError. This follows EVM convention.

ambiguities.text: Order of operands 'Pops left, then right; compares left < right' - the popping order determines which value is 'left'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume first pop is left operand, second pop is right operand. Comparison is left < right where left is stack[0] and right is stack[1] at start.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EVM has at least the required number of operands on the stack before executing comparison instructions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stack underflow error would occur, halting execution and reverting state changes

implicit_assumptions.description: The signed conversion .to_signed() correctly handles 256-bit two's complement representation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect signed comparison results could lead to wrong control flow in smart contracts relying on SGT/SLT

implicit_assumptions.description: GAS_VERY_LOW constant is set to an appropriate value that prevents denial of service through comparison spam
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could perform excessive comparison operations cheaply, potentially impacting node performance
